company.name: Glass Wall Systems (India)
company.summary: Architectural façades, glass curtain walls, louvers and external cladding for buildings.
company.description: Glass Wall Systems designs, manufactures and installs building-envelope systems. Its façades form the outer skin of residential, commercial and hospitality buildings. It combines engineering and fabrication with project execution, so a building project’s timing matters to both revenue and cash collection.
company.ownership: This profile covers Glass Wall Systems (India) Limited. Its clients and named project buildings are not subsidiaries merely because they appear in the project portfolio. It supplies façade solutions rather than being a general glass retailer.
company.money: It earns from façade-engineering and supply-and-installation contracts. Project progress, material procurement, installation productivity, retention amounts and collection timing affect margins and operating cash flow.
watch: Does the order pipeline turn into completed, billed work on schedule?
Are aluminium, glass and other input costs reflected in contract pricing?
How much cash remains tied up until milestones or project completion?
risks: Client approvals, site readiness and project funding can delay installation.
Custom engineering and material-price changes can reduce contract profitability.
Façade performance, installation safety and warranty claims create execution risk.
company.question: Does a large façade order book mean the same amount of cash is already in the bank?
company.answer: No. Orders still need to be executed, billed and collected, and some payments may be retained until completion or other contractual conditions are met.
update: A project portfolio shows capability, not ownership
Buildings on the website illustrate projects supplied by the company. Assess execution, margins and receivables separately.
